text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has invited me to help<n>with a
harvest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That should do it, I think. Just<n>look at this
bounty of vegetables.
choice_data_list: What made you want to help out with farming?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The vegetarian diets of Buddhist<n>monks caught my
attention recently.<n>My own diet lacks consistency,
and I<n>seem to have put on a little weight<n>because of
it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I figured I should increase my intake<n>of fresh fruits
and vegetables, and so<n>I got permission to help
with the<n>harvests.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A change in diet clears the mind... It's<n>wonderful
what opportunities Japan<n>has to offer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I can't wait to cook with these<n>tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder comes up to me a few<n>days later
and happily tells me how<n>her new diet has been
working<n>wonders.
